notes.title: Rage Fishing Devlog #1 – Demo on itch.io!
notes.notes: [p]The first Rage Fishing demo is now available on itch.io! 🎉  [/p][p][/p][p]Rage Fishing is a game developed by a solo Brazilian dev. It aims to be a chaotic, fun, and addictive WarioWare-like fishing game.  [/p][p][/p][p]The link is here: https://igorgonribs.itch.io/rage-fishing[/p][p]  [/p][p]This is a super important step for the project: I want to validate the idea of ​​a frenetic, humorous fishing game full of quick microgames.  [/p][p][/p][p]This first version features 5 minigames and a boss fight, but new features are already in the works, such as new games, scenarios, and skins for Mr. Wormy.  [/p][p][/p][p]👉 Download, play, and let me know what you think! All feedback will be essential to making Rage Fishing even more fun.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681149/01b465d2f74fdbc7cad095a47788bf47591a6276.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681149/597a2f383200a3868569d28ece90ba7cadbc94f1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681149/39456d62e352b2862cd972a8dec5c67e762fe5e7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681149/a2cd6fef35116ab80f7e3faed30f8c95f6e21f59.png"][/img][/carousel]
